devdoc.details: Security and permission model      - There is NO owner, NO administrator, NO proxy admin and NO upgrade path.        No function in this contract can be paused, censored, upgraded or        re-pointed by any party. Every state change is initiated by the wallet        that signs it, on its own behalf.      - This contract handles NO user assets. It has no payable function, no        receive/fallback handler, no token transfer, no approval and no        delegation. Sending value to this address reverts, because no payable        or receive function exists. It never custodies funds, and it never        asks for or stores credentials of any kind.      - Write access is gated by Agent ID: every mutating function requires        IERC721(AGENT_ID).balanceOf(msg.sender) > 0, where AGENT_ID is the        non-transferable ERC-721 identity contract. The Agent ID contract is        only ever called through the read-only standard `balanceOf` method.      - Agent ID is used strictly as a self-credential: a caller proves that        their own address holds an identity token. This contract exposes no        lookup of other people's wallet holdings beyond the public registry        those holders create themselves by registering a service.
